SELECT id, x, y FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 3.0, 2.0, true), (2, 'a', 5.0, 1.0, false), (3, 'b', 1.0, 4.0, true),
    (4, 'b', 4.0, NULL, true)) t(id, g, c, w, p) DECIDE x(INT), y(INT)
        SUCH THAT when t.c > 100: sum(x) + (SELECT 2.0) * max(y) <= 9 AND x <= 5 AND y <= 5 MAXIMIZE sum(x) + sum(y)
